name: rfc8032-7-1-test2
description: Ed25519 keypair pinned to RFC 8032 §7.1 Test 2. Secondary keypair: the trust-registry issuer key for Level 2 organization-attestation fixtures, and the substituted key in the key-substituted negative fixture. The encoded forms below are all derivations of the same 32-byte public key and 32-byte private seed; the generator recomputes them from the seed on every run.
warning: These keys are published in RFC 8032 itself and are for cross-implementation verification only. They MUST NOT be used to sign anything in any production deployment.
